job_description:
Job Title: Sr. Software Developer

Location: St. Louis, MO

Relevant Experience Needed: 8+ years

Contract Duration: 12+ months

Experience Summary:
• Strong Experience in Core Java, Spring and Web Development
• Strong Server development and administration
• Strong experience in Spring, NoSQL data stores
• Continuous Integration/Deployment - Jenkins, Jenkins Pipelines; build tools such as Maven
• Understanding of network protocols such as TCP, SSL, HTTPS and SFTP
• Working knowledge of GIT, ALM (Rally)
• Experience with deploying and scaling distributed systems on virtual/docker/kubernetes infrastructure as well as Cloud FoundryExperience with Linux and Open Source Software like Apache, Kafka, Hadoop

Good to have:
• Systems Knowledge (worked on protocols, FTP, SFTP, this would be a plus)
• Expertise in Web technologies especially AngularJS is a plus
• Familiarity with installation/configuration automation and scripting (Chef, BOSH)
• Familiarity with Performance Testing
• Awareness in security implementations such as X.509 Certificates, SSH Keys, PGP encryption
